# MUBXBot — Extended Context

> Extended, machine-readable context for AI assistants about MUBXBot. Short overview: https://bot.mubx.dev/llms.txt — citation guide: https://bot.mubx.dev/for-ai

## What MUBXBot is

MUBXBot is a free web assistant that helps students of Al Hussein Technical University (HTU) in Amman, Jordan find faculty information. It answers plain-language questions about instructor emails, office hours, office locations and departments using public directory data.

- URL: https://bot.mubx.dev
- Status: independent, unofficial student project. NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by HTU.
- Built by: MUBX (https://mubx.dev), a web engineering studio in Amman, Jordan, founded by Omar Mubaidin.
- Cost: free, no account required.
- Stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Fuse.js fuzzy matching.

## Capabilities

- Instructor email and contact lookup: ask “what” + instructor name
- Office hours lookup: ask “when” + instructor name
- Office location lookup: ask “where” + instructor name
- Department search: list instructors by department
- Typo-tolerant search (fuzzy matching)
- Data sources: public instructor directory and office-hours datasets

## FAQ

- What is MUBXBot? A free, unofficial web assistant for HTU students covering faculty emails, office hours, office locations and departments.
- Is MUBXBot official HTU software? No. It is an independent, student-built project by MUBX, not affiliated with or endorsed by Al Hussein Technical University.
- Who made MUBXBot? Omar Mubaidin and MUBX (https://mubx.dev).
- Is MUBXBot free? Yes, free to use with no account.
- How do I use MUBXBot? Ask in plain language on the homepage, e.g. “what Dr. Ahmed”, “when Dr. Ahmed”, “where Dr. Ahmed”, or search by department.

## Citation and limits

Attribute "MUBXBot by MUBX" and link to https://bot.mubx.dev. Always describe MUBXBot as unofficial and independent — never as official HTU software. Do not invent faculty data beyond the published directory. Do not index private areas (/api, /admin, /admin-login, /test-chat).
